description: Use when an agent must verify a company or find its LEI: by lei= the legal name, status, legal form, addresses, registration renewal date, direct and ultimate parent and BIC. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /company/lei, $0.005 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

country.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country of the legal address to narrow a name search, e.g. DE.

lei.description: 20-character Legal Entity Identifier (ISO 17442). Give lei or name.

name.description: Company name to search (2-100 characters); returns up to 10 ranked matches. Give lei or name.
